summary: Secret-trading game with a wallet-free simulation and an experimental Sapient path. The creator’s October 28 forum edit supplies a replacement demo and source archive after GitHub became unavailable; both mirrors were reachable on October 29. The archive is labeled snapshot 683bc4e and contains a BSD-3-Clause license. The former repository is https://github.com/Lrifton92/crypt. The mirrored ON-CHAIN · SAPIENT screen warns that 15 testnet XTM remain in settled escrow because the browser wallet cannot sign the Rust SDK stealth payout; reloading mid-sale abandons the session. Disputes reveal secrets and public metadata remains visible. The refreshed recording shows these requirements and the title screen; no wallet or transaction was used. Earlier simulation footage remains in capture history.
